rotation.note: Operator override: the FULL science keyword set is used as seeds (all 4 core + all 50 flat keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date rotation (19 mod 7 = 5) is applied to EMPHASIS ordering only. Today's theme order: cognition/psychology -> research automation -> life science -> materials -> astronomy -> physics/climate -> quantum. This pushes astronomy (lunar foundation model 09-18/09-12), climate/energy planning (09-18), self-driving-lab chemistry (09-17), quantum optimization (09-17) and neuromorphic hardware (09-17) to the back of the query list, and leads with cognition/psychology + research-automation angles that have not been mined for two days.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items with pubDate inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then run WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.preprint_hint: arxiv.org and biorxiv.org expose per-category Atom/RSS: https://rss.arxiv.org/rss/<cat> (cs.LG, cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.NE, q-bio.BM, q-bio.NC, cond-mat.mtrl-sci, astro-ph.IM, physics.plasm-ph, quant-ph) and https://connect.biorxiv.org/biorxiv_xml.php?subject=bioinformatics|biophysics|neuroscience|synthetic_biology. Preprints need a listed submission date to pass the gate.
retrieval_hint.relevance_gate: Per sources.json _note: keep only items where AI actually advances or intersects scientific research/method. Drop pure AI-industry news (funding, compute buildout, hiring, model marketing).
retrieval_hint.blocked_outlet_note: statnews/scientificamerican often paywall after the lede — still usable if published_time and an og:image are verifiable; phys.org images come from the scx1.b-cdn.net CDN.
